The '''Talisman of the Bolma''' was a [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsister]] [[Talisman of Transformation]] that allowed its wearer to [[Metamorphosis|take the shape]] of the [[bolma]],<ref name="BoS" /> a [[Reptile/Legends|reptile]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]].<ref name="SWG">{{GalaxiesAED}}</ref>

In her book ''[[Wild Power]]'', [[Mother (title)/Legends|Mother]] [[Talzin/Legends|Talzin]] wrote about the talisman.<ref name="BoS" />
